findings.evidence: Distinguishes public signature migration from internal narrowing; preserves failure timing and capture protocol. Explains shallow records/list copying, mutable elements, null rejection and multi-read atomicity limitations.

findings.evidence: Navigation in a mapper can be intentional, while I/O and consistency still require evidence. Reduced source/import coupling does not prove fewer queries or runtime benefit.
findings.consequence: No unconditional ORM, remote-call or performance assumption needs correction.

sources.support: Receiver domains include parameters, computed/stored immediate parts and objects created by the method. The skill correctly identifies its common shorthand as incomplete and separates pragmatic schema contracts from a formal checker.
Records are shallowly immutable carriers, with component references and accessors. The keyword cannot establish deep immutability or turn a live collaborator into a snapshot.
copyOf provides an unmodifiable list, rejects null collection/elements and does not freeze mutable element state. Existing snapshot/null cautions are appropriate.
sources.verification: Official copyOf and unmodifiable-list contracts consulted.

sources.support: getFirst is available since 21 and throws NoSuchElementException for an empty list; skill states both limitations and the Java 17 alternative with an explicit empty-input contract.
sources.verification: Official method availability and failure contract consulted.

sources.support: map applies a supplied function and converts a null result to empty; dataflow syntax does not remove the function dependencies or preserve arbitrary navigation null semantics by itself. Existing call-path/null and callback guards cover that risk.
sources.verification: Official API documentation consulted; no Optional rewrite was proposed or executed.

sources.support: Null switch selectors fail; the worked membership null guard preserves the original equality-check fallback instead of silently changing it.
sources.verification: Official specification consulted, with switch-expression section 15.28 also inspected.
